rule: A single joint rated 3 (1-5) makes the day Yellow; Green needs all joints <= 2
summary: Subjective self-report tracks training response better than objective markers (Saw 2016), and a moderate joint rating is a reasonable trigger to trim the day. The number is a heuristic on an unvalidated scale; low cost because Yellow only moderates the session.

sources.note: Saw 2016 SR (56 studies): subjective self-report measures track training load more sensitively than objective markers
OSTRC weekly questionnaire (knee/low back/shoulder): repeated self-report captures far more overuse problems than time-loss reporting
